params.name: in_particles
params.label: Input particles
params.help: particles.star file (e.g. from a SPA Preprocessing job). New particles are classified in batches while the file grows.

params.name: batch_size
params.label: Batch size
params.help: Minimum number of particles to create a new batch for 2D classification.

params.name: group_column
params.label: Group column
params.help: Optional column used to avoid splitting groups between batches (e.g. rlnMicrographName).

params.name: wait.timeout
params.label: Input timeout (s)
params.help: Stop after this time (in seconds) without new input particles, classifying the remaining ones.

params.name: gpus
params.label: GPUs
params.help: One processing thread will be created for each value, using Relion's --gpu syntax, e.g. '0,1 2,3' runs two threads with two GPUs each.

params.label: Launchers
params.help: Launchers to use for the different programs. If empty, the ones from EMWRAP_CONFIG['programs'] are used.

params.name: launcher_relion
params.label: RELION
params.help: Launcher to use for Relion (receives the program name as first argument)
